segment.source: <end>

segment.source: How did you get yourself in such a large debt?<end>
segment.target: How did you get yourself in such a large debt?<end>

segment.source: It's because I'm stupid, that's how. It's because I'm a freaking gambler who had to borrow money from lotsa dangerous people. Hell, I thought my bad luck streak had to end at some point and that I was finally gonna win and pay them back, no problem. Ah muck, was I an idiot. <end>
segment.target: It's because I'm stupid, that's how. It's because I'm a freaking gambler who had to borrow money from lotsa dangerous people. Hell, I thought my bad luck streak had to end at some point and that I was finally gonna win and pay them back, no problem. Ah muck, was I an idiot. <end>

segment.source: And those guys were just one of many I borrowed money from. Gambling sure seems like it was invented by the Tchort himself.<end>

segment.source: Tchort?<end>
segment.target: Tchort?<end>

segment.source: You heard that derailed guy shouting about Tchort? It's like some... horrible god or whatever. Crazy stuff. While a stalactite must've fallen on that guy's head, the word "Tchort" sure has a cool ring to it.<end>

segment.source: I hope you've finally learned your lesson. I have more questions for you.<end>
segment.target: I hope you've finally learned your lesson. I have more questions for you.<end>

segment.source: Yeah?<end>
segment.target: Yeah?<end>

segment.source: Who were those guys?<end>
segment.target: Who were those guys?<end>

segment.source: Just some small gang I borrowed some money from. To gamble. I, a complete moron, just had to borrow money from lotsa dangerous people. Hell, I thought my bad luck streak had to end at some point and that I was finally gonna win and pay them back, no problem. Ah, muck, was I an idiot. <end>

segment.source: Sad to say it, but yeah. My mind is now clear: I realize how close I was to dying because of my stupidity. Ah, muck! As soon as we're done here, I'm leaving Foundry with Anna. I'm not gonna wait for someone else to come looking for their money and end up in the same muck. Err, situation.<end>

segment.source: No, no. Not again.<end>
segment.target: No, no. Not again.<end>

segment.source: Did those guys happen to have some distinct item with them that you were able to notice? <end>
segment.target: Did those guys happen to have some distinct item with them that you were able to notice? <end>

segment.source: Not as far as I know. Now that you ask me that, Cornell had something pretty interesting with him.<end>
segment.target: Not as far as I know. Now that you ask me that, Cornell had something pretty interesting with him.<end>

segment.source: Cornell?<end>
segment.target: Cornell?<end>

segment.source:
My mucky "friend" who sold me out to Jacek and his gang. He's a scavenger. We used to do some small jobs together in the early days; used to be a good friend of mine. But, I guess money's more important than friendship... Hell, we even had a couple of drinks together and he promised me a small job that'll help me earn some coins. And then he led me straight into Jacek's paws!
Lying bastard!<end>

segment.source: Listen, he kept something in a metal case: It looked like a strange twenty-sided thingy with some... some odd symbols. Pretty outlandish if you ask me. I managed to take a peek, that's how I know.<end>
